about: Built-in effect stacks (ledger:M177): chains from live sets the person liked, saved by name. fx_stack_list shows them with their cost on this machine; live_track(fx='stack:<name>') uses one.

kit70_glue.notes: glue for the 70s kit (kit70, humanize 7 ms, cym_bright 0.35), from the 10-07 Addis freestyle

dirty_pbass.notes: dirty P-bass through an amp and cab (the electric voice, kind pbass); the person: "it's dirty"

afrobeat_tenor.notes: bright Afrobeat tenor guitar (strat mono, damp 0.6), from the 10-07 Afrobeat freestyle

afrobeat_chank.notes: the Afrobeat rhythm chank: univibe chorus into the bright amp (strat poly, strum 9 ms)

tonewheel_organ.notes: rotary speaker for the tonewheel organ (drawbars 808400000, perc 0.3); automate speed 0 to 1 at the peaks
